description: This header file declares internal functions related to the Slap Obj Container Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes function prototypes for managing interface pointers, container properties, and component management functions.

methods.name: SlapOcoGetSlapUoaIf
methods.description: Retrieves the Slap UOA Interface associated with the object.

methods.name: SlapOcoSetSlapUoaIf
methods.description: Sets the Slap UOA Interface for the object.

methods.name: SlapOcoGetSlapBssIf
methods.description: Retrieves the Slap BSS Interface associated with the object.

methods.name: SlapOcoSetSlapBssIf
methods.description: Sets the Slap BSS Interface for the object.

methods.name: SlapOcoGetSlapObjMapper
methods.description: Retrieves the Object Mapper associated with the object.

methods.name: SlapOcoSetSlapObjMapper
methods.description: Sets the Object Mapper for the object.

methods.name: SlapOcoGetContainerName
methods.description: Gets the name of the container.

methods.name: SlapOcoSetContainerName
methods.description: Sets the name of the container.

methods.name: SlapOcoGetContainerType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the container.

methods.name: SlapOcoSetContainerType
methods.description: Sets the type of the container.

methods.name: SlapOcoReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the object.

methods.name: SlapOcoAssignInstanceId
methods.description: Assigns an instance ID based on the object's name.

methods.name: SlapOcoGetSrvComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a service component by name and instance ID.

methods.name: SlapOcoAddSrvComponent
methods.description: Adds a new service component to the container.

methods.name: SlapOcoDelAllSrvComponents
methods.description: Deletes all service components from the container.
